description: Source code for a command utility that interacts with a module via JSON-RPC over TCP, providing menu-driven API invocation and module management functions.

methods.name: printOptions
methods.description: Displays menu options by reading a configuration file, filtering based on module name and user choice.

methods.name: getAgentResponse
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to a local server, sends a JSON command, and retrieves the response.

methods.name: getStubFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the stub function name from configuration file based on line number and module name.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Reads a string input from standard input.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists on the filesystem.

methods.name: getuserin
methods.description: Frames JSON parameters by prompting user for input based on parameter types.

methods.name: getreqin
methods.description: Frames JSON parameters from predefined request parameters.

methods.name: sighandler
methods.description: Handles termination signals to unload module and exit gracefully.
